dc_july4.recommended_plan: Drive to Greenbelt Metro, free ride home after 5 PM

itinerary.activity: Leave Fort Meade, drive to Greenbelt Metro (gates don't open until 5 PM — no need for an early start)
Board Metro Green Line toward L'Enfant Plaza / Smithsonian
Arrive National Mall. Smithsonian museums open (free, fully air-conditioned)
Early lunch near the Mall before the flyover crowd builds
Military flyovers begin — visible from the National Mall area (no security ticket needed for this)
Flyovers continue every hour until sunset. Stay cool inside Smithsonian museums between shows
Begin heading to Freedom 250 security lines — Freedom 250 advises not to arrive before 4 PM
Gates open. Pass through security magnetometers (clear bag, ID, no chairs/coolers/aerosols)
On the Mall: claim your viewing spot, grab food from vendors, enjoy the pre-show atmosphere
President Trump speaks
Fireworks display begins (~40 minutes, 850,000 shells from 10 launch sites)
Fireworks end. Exit with crowd toward Metro station (allow 30–60 min to clear)
Free Metro ride back to Greenbelt (Metro runs until 2 AM, free from 5 PM)
Drive home from Greenbelt Metro
